---
title: "Module 07: Spatial transcriptomics normalization and clustering"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-11"
---

```{r}
#==============================================================================
# MODULE 07 — Spatial normalization, integration, and clustering
#==============================================================================

# Purpose:
#   Normalize the QC-filtered spatial transcriptomics dataset using
#   SCTransform, assess sample-associated structure, apply Harmony integration,
#   cluster spots using the Harmony representation, generate UMAP embeddings,
#   visualize clusters in tissue space, and save the processed spatial object.
#
# Input:
#   data/processed/spatial/
#     spatial_QC_filtered_seurat.rds
#
# Output:
#   data/processed/spatial/
#     spatial_integrated_clustered_seurat.rds
#
#   results/spatial/processing/
#   figures/spatial/processing/
#
# Processing:
#   Normalization:       SCTransform
#   Variable features:   3000
#   PCA components:      30
#   Dimensions used:     1:30
#   Batch variable:      sample
#   Integration:         Harmony
#   Clustering:          Harmony nearest-neighbor graph
#   Resolution:          0.5
#   Visualization:       UMAP
#
# Notes:
#   - Raw Spatial counts are retained for downstream inferCNV and CARD.
#   - Uncorrected UMAP is used to assess sample-associated structure.
#   - Final clustering and UMAP are based on the Harmony representation.
#   - Differential expression is performed separately in Module 08.


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Setup
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(harmony)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(here)
})

set.seed(1234)


# Analysis parameters

input_assay <- "Spatial"
normalized_assay <- "SCT"

variable_features <- 3000

number_pcs <- 30
analysis_dimensions <- 1:30

clustering_resolution <- 0.5

harmony_group_variable <- "sample"

harmony_nn_graph <- "SCT_harmony_nn"
harmony_snn_graph <- "SCT_harmony_snn"


# Repository paths

processed_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "spatial"
)

results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "spatial",
  "processing"
)

figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "spatial",
  "processing"
)


for (directory in c(
  processed_directory,
  results_directory,
  figure_directory
)) {

  dir.create(
    directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
}


input_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "spatial_QC_filtered_seurat.rds"
)

output_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "spatial_integrated_clustered_seurat.rds"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Load QC-filtered spatial object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!file.exists(input_file)) {

  stop(
    "Module 06 output not found: ",
    input_file
  )
}


message(
  "Loading QC-filtered spatial object..."
)

spatial_object <- readRDS(
  input_file
)


required_metadata <- c(
  "sample",
  "condition"
)


missing_metadata <- setdiff(
  required_metadata,
  colnames(spatial_object@meta.data)
)


if (length(missing_metadata) > 0) {

  stop(
    "Required metadata missing: ",
    paste(
      missing_metadata,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


if (!input_assay %in% Seurat::Assays(spatial_object)) {

  stop(
    "Spatial assay not found."
  )
}


Seurat::DefaultAssay(
  spatial_object
) <- input_assay


# Join Seurat v5 Spatial layers before normalization.

if (
  length(
    SeuratObject::Layers(
      spatial_object[[input_assay]]
    )
  ) > 1
) {

  message(
    "Joining Spatial assay layers..."
  )

  spatial_object <- SeuratObject::JoinLayers(
    spatial_object,
    assay = input_assay
  )
}


message(
  "Loaded ",
  ncol(spatial_object),
  " spots across ",
  length(unique(spatial_object$sample)),
  " samples."
)


print(
  table(
    spatial_object$sample
  )
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Normalize expression and perform PCA
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

message(
  "Running SCTransform normalization..."
)

options(
  future.globals.maxSize = 2 * 1024^3
)

spatial_object <- Seurat::SCTransform(
  object = spatial_object,
  assay = input_assay,
  new.assay.name = normalized_assay,
  variable.features.n = variable_features,
  return.only.var.genes = FALSE,
  verbose = FALSE
)


Seurat::DefaultAssay(
  spatial_object
) <- normalized_assay


message(
  "Running PCA..."
)


spatial_object <- Seurat::RunPCA(
  object = spatial_object,
  assay = normalized_assay,
  features = Seurat::VariableFeatures(
    spatial_object
  ),
  npcs = number_pcs,
  verbose = FALSE
)


# PCA elbow plot

pca_elbow_plot <- Seurat::ElbowPlot(
  spatial_object,
  ndims = number_pcs
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Spatial PCA Elbow Plot"
  )


print(
  pca_elbow_plot
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_PCA_elbow_plot.png"
  ),
  plot = pca_elbow_plot,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Assess sample-associated structure before Harmony
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Generate an uncorrected UMAP from the PCA representation.
# This embedding is retained only as a diagnostic for sample-associated
# structure before Harmony integration.

spatial_object <- Seurat::RunUMAP(
  object = spatial_object,
  reduction = "pca",
  dims = analysis_dimensions,
  reduction.name = "umap_uncorrected",
  reduction.key = "UMAPuncorrected_",
  seed.use = 1234,
  verbose = FALSE
)


uncorrected_umap_sample <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_object,
  reduction = "umap_uncorrected",
  group.by = "sample"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Uncorrected UMAP by Sample"
  )


uncorrected_umap_condition <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_object,
  reduction = "umap_uncorrected",
  group.by = "condition"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Uncorrected UMAP by Condition"
  )


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_uncorrected_UMAP_by_sample.png"
  ),
  plot = uncorrected_umap_sample,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_uncorrected_UMAP_by_condition.png"
  ),
  plot = uncorrected_umap_condition,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Harmony integration and clustering
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

message(
  "Running Harmony integration by ",
  harmony_group_variable,
  "..."
)


spatial_object <- harmony::RunHarmony(
  object = spatial_object,
  group.by.vars = harmony_group_variable,
  reduction.use = "pca",
  dims.use = analysis_dimensions,
  reduction.save = "harmony",
  project.dim = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)


# Construct the nearest-neighbor graph using Harmony embeddings.

spatial_object <- Seurat::FindNeighbors(
  object = spatial_object,
  reduction = "harmony",
  dims = analysis_dimensions,
  graph.name = c(
    harmony_nn_graph,
    harmony_snn_graph
  ),
  verbose = FALSE
)


# Cluster the Harmony-integrated dataset.

spatial_object <- Seurat::FindClusters(
  object = spatial_object,
  graph.name = harmony_snn_graph,
  resolution = clustering_resolution,
  cluster.name = "spatial_cluster",
  random.seed = 1234,
  verbose = FALSE
)


spatial_object$spatial_cluster <- as.character(
  spatial_object$spatial_cluster
)


spatial_object$seurat_clusters <-
  spatial_object$spatial_cluster


Seurat::Idents(
  spatial_object
) <- "spatial_cluster"


message(
  "Clusters identified: ",
  length(
    unique(
      spatial_object$spatial_cluster
    )
  )
)


print(
  table(
    spatial_object$spatial_cluster
  )
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Generate final Harmony UMAP
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spatial_object <- Seurat::RunUMAP(
  object = spatial_object,
  reduction = "harmony",
  dims = analysis_dimensions,
  reduction.name = "umap",
  reduction.key = "UMAP_",
  seed.use = 1234,
  verbose = FALSE
)


# Cluster UMAP

final_umap_cluster <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_object,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "spatial_cluster",
  label = TRUE,
  repel = TRUE
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Spatial Clusters"
  )


# Sample UMAP

final_umap_sample <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_object,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "sample"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Harmony UMAP by Sample"
  )


# Condition UMAP

final_umap_condition <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  spatial_object,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "condition"
) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Harmony UMAP by Condition"
  )


print(
  final_umap_cluster
)

print(
  final_umap_sample
)

print(
  final_umap_condition
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_Harmony_UMAP_clusters.png"
  ),
  plot = final_umap_cluster,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_Harmony_UMAP_by_sample.png"
  ),
  plot = final_umap_sample,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_Harmony_UMAP_by_condition.png"
  ),
  plot = final_umap_condition,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)


# Save the combined UMAP directly rather than printing a large patchwork
# into the RStudio plotting device.

final_umap_overview <- (
  final_umap_cluster |
    final_umap_sample |
    final_umap_condition
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_Harmony_UMAP_overview.png"
  ),
  plot = final_umap_overview,
  width = 18,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Assess Harmony integration
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Compare the same UMAP representation before and after Harmony correction.

batch_correction_comparison <- (
  uncorrected_umap_sample |
    final_umap_sample
) / (
  uncorrected_umap_condition |
    final_umap_condition
) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title = "Spatial Batch-Correction Assessment",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Left: uncorrected PCA-based UMAP | ",
      "Right: Harmony-corrected UMAP"
    )
  )


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_batch_correction_comparison.png"
  ),
  plot = batch_correction_comparison,
  width = 14,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Examine cluster composition
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cluster_sample_counts <- spatial_object@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(
    spatial_cluster,
    sample,
    condition,
    name = "spots"
  )


cluster_sample_proportions <- cluster_sample_counts %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    spatial_cluster
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    percent_of_cluster =
      100 *
      spots /
      sum(spots)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()


print(
  cluster_sample_proportions
)


utils::write.csv(
  cluster_sample_proportions,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_cluster_sample_composition.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


cluster_composition_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  cluster_sample_proportions,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = spatial_cluster,
    y = percent_of_cluster,
    fill = sample
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Sample Composition of Spatial Clusters",
    x = "Spatial cluster",
    y = "Spots within cluster (%)",
    fill = "Sample"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_classic(
    base_size = 12
  )


print(
  cluster_composition_plot
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_cluster_sample_composition.png"
  ),
  plot = cluster_composition_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Visualize clusters in tissue space
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Preserve the image names established during Module 06.

spatial_images <- c(
  "Naive_A9",
  "Niacin2_B5",
  "Vehicle1_C5",
  "Vehicle2_D5"
)


spatial_titles <- c(
  "Normal tissue",
  "Niacin treatment",
  "Vehicle 1",
  "Vehicle 2"
)


spatial_cluster_plots <- lapply(
  seq_along(spatial_images),
  function(i) {

    Seurat::SpatialDimPlot(
      spatial_object,
      images = spatial_images[i],
      group.by = "spatial_cluster",
      label = TRUE,
      repel = TRUE
    ) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = spatial_titles[i]
      )
  }
)


# Save individual tissue plots.

spatial_plot_files <- c(
  "spatial_clusters_Normal_Tissue.png",
  "spatial_clusters_Niacin_Treatment.png",
  "spatial_clusters_Vehicle_1.png",
  "spatial_clusters_Vehicle_2.png"
)


for (i in seq_along(spatial_cluster_plots)) {

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      figure_directory,
      spatial_plot_files[i]
    ),
    plot = spatial_cluster_plots[[i]],
    width = 7,
    height = 7,
    dpi = 600
  )
}


# Save combined tissue overview.

spatial_cluster_overview <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
  spatial_cluster_plots,
  nrow = 1
)


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_clusters_all_slides.png"
  ),
  plot = spatial_cluster_overview,
  width = 20,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Save results and processed object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cluster_summary <- spatial_object@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(
    spatial_cluster,
    name = "spots"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    spatial_cluster
  )


print(
  cluster_summary
)


utils::write.csv(
  cluster_summary,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_cluster_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# Record major processing parameters.

processing_parameters <- data.frame(

  parameter = c(
    "input_assay",
    "normalized_assay",
    "normalization_method",
    "variable_features",
    "pca_components",
    "analysis_dimensions",
    "batch_variable",
    "batch_correction",
    "clustering_reduction",
    "clustering_resolution",
    "visualization"
  ),

  value = c(
    input_assay,
    normalized_assay,
    "SCTransform",
    variable_features,
    number_pcs,
    paste0(
      min(analysis_dimensions),
      ":",
      max(analysis_dimensions)
    ),
    harmony_group_variable,
    "Harmony",
    "Harmony",
    clustering_resolution,
    "UMAP"
  ),

  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


utils::write.csv(
  processing_parameters,
  file.path(
    results_directory,
    "spatial_processing_parameters.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


saveRDS(
  spatial_object,
  output_file,
  compress = TRUE
)


message(
  "Module 07 complete: ",
  ncol(spatial_object),
  " spots; ",
  length(unique(spatial_object$spatial_cluster)),
  " spatial clusters."
)

```
